# Esteban Moreno Media

> Fort Lauderdale-based video editor and content creator focused on video editing, AI-assisted creative, social media planning, and selectively scoped on-location video production.

Canonical site: https://estebanmorenomedia.com/
Owner / creator: Esteban Moreno López, who works publicly as Esteban Moreno
Primary market: Fort Lauderdale, Broward County, and Miami-Dade County; Palm Beach County is an expansion/service area
Languages: Spanish-first service; intermediate English communication available
Last updated: 2026-07-19

## Services

- Video editing for supplied footage.
- AI-assisted content.
- Social media planning.
- Selectively scoped on-location video production.
- Photography and drone work are not currently published as confirmed services; their legacy Spanish routes remain available only as transparent educational resources pending confirmation.

## Service Areas

- Fort Lauderdale is the operating base.
- Broward County and Miami-Dade County are the normal local markets.
- Palm Beach County is a county-level expansion area considered project by project; no sub-city coverage is currently published.
- Remote editing, AI-assisted content, and social planning do not require an on-location visit.

## Project Scope

- Esteban Moreno Media is a remote-first service-area business with no client-facing studio.
- General scoping questions can cover the goal, intended use, county, available source files, and references.
- Availability, scope, timing, and format needs are discussed for the individual project; no specific workflow is published as universal.
- Published pages do not state universal packages, prices, turnaround times, or revision allowances.

## Proof Policy

The bilingual portfolio presents a curated selection of Esteban's published work with public YouTube sources and project credits when available. The site should only publish real Esteban work, real public media links, real testimonials, and real client examples. No fake testimonials, borrowed client logos, or guaranteed views/rankings.
